items.title: The count of geometrically irreducible fibre components is constant over an open of the closure of a point
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism, the function counting geometrically irreducible components of the fibres is shown to be constant on a nonempty open subset of the closure of any given point of the base. The proof restricts to the closure of the point, uses the constructibility of the function together with the fact that the generic fibre of the restriction has a definite count, and then spreads the count to a dense open of the closure. Combining constructibility with the generic value is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 7751-7791.
